heroSub: FiveStar AI yana tsarawa da gina kowane nau'in software - wayar hannu, yanar gizo, tebur, baya, da AI - ta amfani da LLMs don aiki a cikin yarukan shirye-shirye da tarin fasaha.
m1Sub: AI a duk faɗin ƙira, coding & QA
m4Sub: Ƙaddamar, aiki da ci gaba da ingantawa
aboutLead: Mu kamfani ne na software na asali na AI tare da ƙwarewa mai zurfi a cikin ci gaban LLM. Muna juya matsalolin kasuwanci zuwa samfuran abin dogaro ba tare da iyakance ta takamaiman yaren shirye-shirye, dandamali, ko tarin fasaha ba.
missionBody: Muna amfani da AI da LLMs don zaɓar kayan aikin da suka dace don kowace matsala da kuma isar da duk tarin fasaha.
principlesBody: AI yana haɓaka aikin; injiniyoyinmu sun kasance masu alhakin gine-gine, inganci, tsaro, da sakamako.
focusBody: Wayar hannu, gidan yanar gizo, tebur, bangon baya, wakilan AI, tsarin bayanai, da sarrafa kayan aiki.
productsLead: Kayayyakinmu suna nuna yadda muke ɗaukar ra'ayoyi don ƙaddamar da AI, wayar hannu, takardu, kafofin watsa labarai, da software na samarwa.
p1: Tsarin aikin OCR don takardun da aka yi scan: ciro bayanai, bincika, taƙaitawa, TTS—da kiyaye sirri ta hanyar sarrafawa a na’ura.
p2: Mai sauri, mai sauƙin watsa labarai na gida ba tare da talla ba da gogewa mai santsi a kan dandamalin wayar hannu.
p4: Manhaja wacce ke haɗaka da AI na gida don ba da damar sarrafawa a wurare daban-daban da tattaunawa ta sirri.
p5: Sanya hotunan App Store su zama masu sauƙin fassara da daidaita da harsuna daban-daban don mika su.
p6: Hira ta kusa mai amfani da Bluetooth tare da amincewar mai amfani, tare da zaɓin fassara ta local AI. Babu buƙatar account, kuma babu central chat server.
p7: Manajan pass mai gane wuri. Yana nuna muku coupon ko katin memba da ya dace a lokacin da kuka isa.
p3: Daga tsarin ciki da sabis na yanar gizo zuwa samfuran hannu, tebur, da samfuran AI. Mun zaɓi mafi kyawun harshe da tari ga kowace matsala.
b2: Wayar hannu, yanar gizo & samfuran tebur
q2: Gwaji ta atomatik & sake dubawa na lamba
servicesLead: Injiniyan haɓakar LLM yana juyar da matsala da aka bayyana a sarari zuwa software mai aiki da sauri.
s1Body: Ƙayyana manufar kasuwanci, masu amfani, ƙuntatawa, da madaidaicin hanyar fasaha.
s2Body: Yi amfani da aikin injiniya na tallafi na LLM don ƙira, aiwatarwa, gwadawa, da maimaitawa a cikin dandamali.
s3Body: Sanya, saka idanu, aiki, da ci gaba da inganta samfurin.
contactLead: Faɗa mana abin da kuke son ginawa. Za mu ba da shawarar hanya mai amfani daga ra'ayi zuwa ƙaddamarwa.
